m1_coverage.fallback_description: M1 bars were present but covered only 93 of 2000 parent bars (4.65% of the window). Mixing M1 chronology on part of the window with the fallback on the rest would make results inside one study incomparable, so no M1 chronology was used: the whole window was resolved with the conservative pessimistic_same_bar_no_subpath fallback, in which a bar touching both the stop and the target is taken as the stop.

data_sufficiency.reason: 2,000 M15 bars cover roughly 30 days of one symbol.
data_sufficiency.needed: Multiple years of contiguous M15 plus covering M1 and broker bid/ask, slippage, commission, swap, margin, and gap observations spanning varied regimes.

decision: Phase 3 redesign is NOT authorized; run S6 and S7 against the incumbent four modes.

gates.question: Are signals where they claim to be?
gates.gate: Every configuration must have p50 drift <= 15 minutes.
gates.measured_value: 9/9 variants within tolerance; worst p50 10.0 min
gates.interval: p50 range 0.0 to 10.0 min; max observed drift 10.0 min
gates.rationale: No S3 anchor variant is void under the pre-written tolerance gate.

gates.question: Does the TP rate clear its bar?
gates.gate: The lower confidence bound of TP-rate margin must be above zero.
gates.measured_value: 12/256 cells clear the lower-bound gate; 244/256 do not
gates.interval: margin -25.00 to 12.00 pp; CI lower bound -30.89 to 1.68 pp
gates.rationale: Passing cells are a sparse subset of an unfrozen 256-cell in-sample surface; promoting them would be forbidden post-hoc selection, not a gate pass.

gates.question: What scale?
gates.gate: Use the complete same-window surface and prefer a broad plateau over a peak.
gates.measured_value: 120/256 cells have positive net R; 112 distinct effective configurations
gates.rationale: The complete surface exists, but 2,000 M15 bars (about 30 days) cannot support selection and the delay grid contains 144 duplicates by construction.

gates.question: Does the hedge earn two extra transaction sides?
gates.gate: The hedge must repay its extra sides in net expectancy or breach probability.
gates.measured_value: at 2 pips/side hedge 7.16 vs synthetic 10.91 net pips/structure; hedge uses 194 vs 75 sides
gates.interval: 2-4 pips/side: hedge 7.16 to -0.84, synthetic 10.91 to 6.91; 24h double-break 56.9%
gates.rationale: The hedge has lower modeled net expectancy throughout the realistic cost interval and no S7 evidence of a compensating breach-probability reduction.

gates.question: Enough cost headroom?
gates.gate: Break-even pips/side must be at least 2x measured broker spread.
gates.measured_value: hedge break-even 3.79 pips/side; headroom 1.90x at 2 pips and 0.95x at 4 pips
gates.interval: modeled spread interval 2 to 4 pips/side; no broker-measured interval
gates.rationale: The hedge misses 2x even at the low end, and the gate explicitly requires measured broker spread rather than the modeled S4 ladder.

gates.question: What RR?
gates.gate: Use conditional hit rates crossed with MAX_AGE_HOURS, not a single sweep.
gates.rationale: The interval spans the break-even requirement and the one-month sample cannot select RR jointly with holding horizon.

gates.question: Does the lock help?
gates.measured_value: lock touched by 24 of 36 conditioned survivors
gates.rationale: S1 describes the incumbent absolute lock; it does not compare lock modes out of sample.

gates.question: Holding horizon?
gates.gate: Confirm the 24h prior out of sample and price swap.
gates.rationale: The descriptive attribution supports studying longer holds, but it is in-sample and financing cost is zero rather than broker-measured.

gates.question: Is the edge real?
gates.gate: Positive in most unseen folds, no dominant session, broad plateau, DSR and PBO reported.
gates.measured_value: no unseen folds, DSR, or PBO; 3 directional concentration flags
gates.interval: S8 net R -46.1556 to 14.8187 in-sample only
gates.rationale: S6 has not run, and S9 shows that three modes draw at least 75% of surviving winners from the long side on a strongly rising month.

gates.question: Prop-survivable?
gates.gate: Monte Carlo breach probability must be comfortably below firm limits.
gates.measured_value: 0/256 deterministic short-window cells breached PropGuard; S7 not run
gates.interval: no Monte Carlo confidence interval or tail distribution exists
gates.rationale: A one-month deterministic replay does not test clustered losses, gap tails, spread tails, concurrent exposure, or time to target.
